summary: The implementation satisfies the saved validation provenance observability plan: workspace detail now exposes validation_provenance with required tier, latest satisfied tier, freshness status, reason code, target identity, and latest validation identity; merge queue rows expose explicit validation tier/freshness/reason fields and full latest_validation identity; console types, formatters, workspace detail, and merge queue drilldown render compact operator labels with explicit unknown/unavailable fallbacks. Targeted API/service and console formatter tests cover fresh, stale, legacy, candidate-attempt scoping, post-rebase filtering, identity fields, and fallback labels. Validation run: uv run --python 3.12 --extra dev pytest tests/unit/api tests/unit/service -q; npm --prefix apps/console run lint; npm --prefix apps/console run typecheck; uv run --python 3.12 --extra dev ruff check src/awf tests; uv run --python 3.12 --extra dev mypy src/awf; node --test apps/console/lib/merge-queue-format.test.mjs.
